pages.name: Caro-Kann: English Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 read Ne5 as a move with no knight able to reach it. Reworded plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: English Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 with White's d-pawn on d2 and Black's pawn on d5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: English, Exchange
pages.notes: The overview and all four plans gave Black an isolated d5-pawn and White a blockade, but after 4.cxd5 it is White who gets the isolated d-pawn once Black regains the pawn and White plays d4. Rewrote overview and all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: English, Exchange, 4...Nf6 5.Nc3 Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 with the d-pawn on d2 and the knight on d5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...dxe4 4.Nxe4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 recaptured on f6 before White's exchange; plan 4 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop after ...gxf6; plan 3 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Two Knights Attack, Mindeno Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Qxf3 or gxf3 before Black's ...Bxf3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3
pages.notes: Plan 2 called f4 a light square and both plans assumed doubled f-pawns and an open g-file after the main line 5.Qxf3. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3 Bxf3 5.Qxf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 said ...Nf6 attacks the f3-queen; plan 4 wrote the queen's squares ambiguously. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3 Bxf3 5.Qxf3 e6 6.d3 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote the bishop's squares ambiguously (Be7/d6) and castling as 0-0; plan 3 did the same for the queen. Rewrote plans 1-3 (reviewer: plan 3's d1 retreat rejected as passive, revised to e2, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3 Bxf3 5.Qxf3 e6 6.d3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed the bishop to d3, where White's own pawn stands. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.
